title: The Empty Letter
author: Tamsin Eastwick
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
